name: oracle_shock_liquidation_collateral_topup
question_template: A fictional DeFi lending market tracks a borrower holding collateral worth {V0} USD at the current oracle price against a stablecoin debt of {D} USD; the pre-shock position is not liquidatable. The oracle price then changes by {S} percent in a single update (negative means a drop), and the collateral value moves proportionally. The position becomes liquidatable only if the debt strictly exceeds {LT} percent of the post-shock collateral value. If liquidatable, exactly one liquidation occurs: the liquidator repays the maximum allowed, which is {CF} percent of the debt (the close factor), and seizes collateral, valued at the post-shock price, equal to the repaid amount times one plus a {F} percent liquidation fee. If not liquidatable, nothing is repaid or seized. Afterwards the borrower must deposit additional collateral, valued at the post-shock price, so that the remaining debt is at most {T} percent of the total collateral value; no deposit is needed if this already holds. What is the minimum additional collateral deposit in USD?

slots.description: Collateral value in USD after the oracle price shock.
Debt repaid by the liquidator, zero if no liquidation occurs.
Collateral value seized including the liquidation fee, zero if none.
Collateral value left after the liquidation, before any deposit.

program:
def solve():
    V0 = Fraction(P["V0"])
    D = Fraction(P["D"])
    S = Fraction(P["S"])
    LT = Fraction(P["LT"])
    CF = Fraction(P["CF"])
    F = Fraction(P["F"])
    T = Fraction(P["T"])
    if D > LT / 100 * V0:
        raise ValueError("pre-shock position is already liquidatable")
    V1 = V0 * (1 + S / 100)
    liquidatable = D > LT / 100 * V1
    if liquidatable:
        repaid = CF / 100 * D
        seized = repaid * (1 + F / 100)
    else:
        repaid = Fraction(0)
        seized = Fraction(0)
    if seized > V1:
        raise ValueError("seized collateral exceeds collateral held")
    D2 = D - repaid
    V2 = V1 - seized
    need = D2 * 100 / T - V2
    topup = need if need > 0 else Fraction(0)
    return {
        "final": topup,
        "post_shock_collateral_value": V1,
        "repaid_debt": repaid,
        "seized_collateral_value": seized,
        "remaining_collateral_value": V2,
    }
